name: asva-desktop
description: ASVA - reads Tally, sends bills and reminders on the shop's own WhatsApp.
author: Almmatix

releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
ASVA 2.1.2.

Tally stability: ASVA now waits properly for Tally to finish loading before it reads. If you open Tally after ASVA, it no longer gets hit too early, which is what could close Tally with a memory error. If a read ever does fail, ASVA stands back for a few minutes instead of retrying straight away.

New financial year: if your Tally company rolls over to a new year, ASVA now tells you clearly and offers to switch, instead of quietly stopping.

Correct ages: an old bill no longer shows as if it started on 1 April, so overdue days, the chase list and your reports read true.

Amounts now read the Indian way (28,29,452 instead of 2,829,280).

Multiple companies: reminders for a second company are now delivered properly, and all companies share one safe sending pace on your number.

Free for every shop until 30 September 2026.
